rules.mechanism: Large or inconsistent changes in vitamin-K intake can affect warfarin response.
rules.management: Maintain a consistent diet and discuss major dietary changes with the anticoagulation care team.

evidence.title: Warfarin and diet guidance
evidence.excerpt: Dietary consistency is important for people using warfarin.

rules.mechanism: Grapefruit can increase exposure to some statins through enzyme inhibition.
rules.management: Avoid grapefruit products unless the prescriber or pharmacist confirms they are appropriate for the exact medicine.

evidence.title: Simvastatin label
evidence.excerpt: Check current product labeling for grapefruit-related warnings.

rules.mechanism: Grapefruit may increase exposure to atorvastatin.
rules.management: Discuss grapefruit intake with a pharmacist or prescriber; recommendations depend on the product and amount consumed.

evidence.title: Atorvastatin label
evidence.excerpt: Use current labeling and patient-specific assessment.

rules.mechanism: Tyramine-rich foods can cause dangerous blood-pressure elevation with nonselective MAO inhibitors.
rules.management: High-risk educational alert: follow the prescribed dietary restrictions and contact the care team with questions.

evidence.title: Phenelzine prescribing information
evidence.excerpt: Current labeling describes dietary precautions for MAO inhibitors.
